pathInstructions.instruction: Action inputs are documented in docs/github-action.md and examples/review.example.yml. Check added/removed/renamed inputs and changed defaults against both.
This is the .loupe.json schema. docs/configuration.md has the field tables and examples/.loupe.json is the canonical example; both must list every field with its real default.
CLI flags are documented in docs/guide.md. Verify flag names, defaults, and the review command's argument format.
Built-in defaults live here. docs/configuration.md, docs/github-action.md, and action.yml descriptions quote them; grep for the old value.

Posted GitHub objects, markers, verdicts, and prior-comment cleanup are described in docs/how-it-works/github-objects.md and docs/how-it-works/first-vs-incremental.md. Diagrams there must match the real call order.
Prompt layers and the output contract are described in docs/how-it-works/context.md and the system-prompt section of docs/configuration.md.
The review pipeline is described step by step in docs/how-it-works/review-run.md; the flowchart and numbered steps must match.
Chat commands are documented in docs/how-it-works/chat.md; the HELP constant and the docs must list the same commands.
